purpose: Teach: 明け方/何せ/とっさ/一々/断じて/どっぷり/浸っ/ふしぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、明け方の仕込みは大変だったわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the dawn prep for the new menu was rough, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, looking back on shared effort. Warm, tired tone. No complaint — just noticing something true about the morning they both lived through.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、何せ新メニューだから、お客様も興味津々ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Well, because it's new, the customers have been so curious about it.
lines.style: Bright energy, a small smile in the voice. Quick pace, light — she's still riding the lift of having done something good. Not breathless, but animated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、とっさに「ありがとう」っておっしゃってくれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One customer said thank you right away — didn't even hesitate.
lines.style: Soft delight. Voice lifts slightly on 「ありがとう」. The pleasure of witnessing small kindness. Tender, brief, like she's sharing something precious that happened in the morning light.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューを一々お客様にご説明する必要はないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, we don't actually need to explain the new menu to every single customer.
lines.style: Quiet realisation, gentle correction. Not lecturing — more like thinking aloud with her. Slight pause before 「explain」, turning it over. Warm but steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店では断じて手抜きしないようにしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: But we mustn't cut corners at the shop — not ever.
lines.style: Firmer now, grounded conviction. Clear attack on the opening word. Not stern, but resolved. The voice of someone who cares about doing things right, speaking to someone she trusts to understand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューのコーヒーにどっぷりはまっていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer got completely absorbed in the new coffee — it was lovely to see.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost wistful. Slower pace. She's picturing it — the customer lost in the coffee, the afternoon light. Tender noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、夕方の光に浸って読書なさるお客様、素敵ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was something beautiful about watching them sit with the evening light, just reading.
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreamy. Soft voice, unhurried. She's painting the image as she speaks. Gentle trailing-off, like she's still watching that moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにお客様が驚かれて、ふしぎな気持ちだったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: When the customer saw the new menu, I felt this strange, quiet joy.
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching for the right feeling. Slight pause at the opening. Soft, intimate tone — she's sharing something inward. Trailing uncertainty that settles into peace by the end.
